invariants.name: Alert Identity
invariants.statement: One logical scoring event maps to exactly one alert identity. Transport retries and sliding-window duplicates aggregate into the existing record rather than creating uncoordinated duplicate rows.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: AlertDeduplicationEngine sliding window & AlertRepository unique constraints

invariants.name: Tenant Isolation
invariants.statement: Alerts, cases, decisions, assignments, reports, and timeline audits are strictly scoped to the authoritative bank_id. Object IDs cannot be accessed or mutated across tenant boundaries.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: enforce_tenant_isolation and _enforce_case_tenant across all API endpoints (HTTP 403)

invariants.name: Transaction Binding
invariants.statement: An alert referring to transaction T remains permanently bound to transaction T. No subsequent mutation may rebind it to a different transaction.

invariants.name: Model Result Binding
invariants.statement: Persisted risk score, classification, model version, and threshold refer to the exact inference event that generated them.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Alert.risk_score and confidence bound to model prediction at inference time

invariants.name: Explanation Binding
invariants.statement: An explanation shown or persisted for an alert corresponds to the same transaction, feature state, and model prediction established by explainability contracts.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: ExplainabilityService.explain_alert bound to active alert features and model output

invariants.name: Severity Consistency
invariants.statement: Alert severity strictly adheres to threshold boundaries (CRITICAL >= 0.9, HIGH >= 0.75, MEDIUM >= 0.5, LOW >= 0.3, INFO < 0.3) without contradicting score.

invariants.name: Case Identity
invariants.statement: Case creation with an Idempotency-Key returns the cached case representation without creating duplicate cases.

invariants.name: Legal State Transition
invariants.statement: Every case state change must belong to CASE_STATE_TRANSITIONS. Illegal state transitions fail closed.

invariants.name: Terminal-State Integrity
invariants.statement: Terminal states (CLOSED_CONFIRMED, CLOSED_FALSE_POSITIVE) are strictly immutable. No transition, reassignment, or alert linking is permitted after closure.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: TerminalCaseImmutableError raised in change_status, assign_case, and link_alert

invariants.name: Decision Provenance
invariants.statement: Every business decision preserves who (actor), what (event_type), when (UTC timestamp), prior state, and cryptographic hash in the case timeline.

invariants.name: Authorization
invariants.statement: Mutations require authorized caller context. Unauthenticated or unauthorized callers cannot mutate business state.

invariants.name: Dual-Control Integrity
invariants.statement: Four-Eyes dual control requires ApproverID != InvestigatorID. The assigned investigator or analyst actor cannot self-approve their own case, regardless of casing or prefixes.

invariants.name: Retry Safety
invariants.statement: Retrying outbound webhook dispatch for the same event yields identical X-CFI-Event-Id to enable downstream deduplication.

invariants.name: Conflict Detection
invariants.statement: Submitting the same idempotency key with conflicting payload fails closed with HTTP 409 Conflict.

invariants.name: Concurrency Safety
invariants.statement: Optimistic concurrency prevents lost updates when two analysts submit competing transitions.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: expected_status precondition check returning HTTP 409 Conflict

invariants.name: Audit History Integrity
invariants.statement: Timeline history is append-only and cryptographically chained. Corrupted blocks or history tampering are detectable via verify_timeline_integrity.

invariants.name: Timestamp Integrity
invariants.statement: All business event timestamps are server-authoritative UTC timestamps. Clients cannot spoof event times.

invariants.name: Regulatory Truthfulness
invariants.statement: FinCEN SAR generation produces a locally validated XML package with SHA-256 seal. It is classified as REPORT_GENERATION/EXPORT_ONLY, not an external submission. Cases resolved as false positives or unreviewed open cases cannot generate SAR packages.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Status precondition check in file_sar_report & RegulatoryReporterService

invariants.name: No Phantom Success
invariants.statement: An operation cannot report success if an authoritative persistence step failed.

invariants.name: No Phantom Failure
invariants.statement: Timeout on external notifications does not cause local business state to rollback if the database transaction committed.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Decoupled background webhook dispatch with failure logging

invariants.name: Historical Consistency
invariants.statement: Case history remains monotonically consistent. Events cannot be deleted or reordered.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Append-only timeline list in Case domain entity

invariants.name: Data Immutability Where Required
invariants.statement: Original transaction identity, initial risk score, and creator identity cannot be rewritten by update APIs.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Pydantic request schemas exclude immutable fields from update payloads

invariants.name: Business/Frontend Consistency
invariants.statement: Frontend-visible states reflect backend CaseStatus enum values without misrepresenting false positives as confirmed fraud.

invariants.name: Failure Atomicity
invariants.statement: Multi-step case status updates rollback cleanly if timeline event hashing fails.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: RLock synchronization and atomic dictionary serialization

invariants.name: Claim Precision
invariants.statement: The term 'CONFIRMED_FRAUD' represents an operational AML team disposition under Four-Eyes dual control signoff, not a judicial finding.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Documentation specification in case_management_spec.md and audit reports
